title: I provided, another gained authority
odia:
ଖୋଇଲି ପେଇଲି ନ ହେଲି କିଛି
ଅଧିକାର କଲା ଗୁହାଳ ପୋଛି।
literal_meaning: I fed and gave drink, yet became nothing; another gained authority by cleaning the cowshed.
meaning_odia: ଖାଇବା ପିଇବା ଦେଇ ମଧ୍ୟ ନିଜେ କିଛି ହେଲି ନାହିଁ, ଅଥଚ ଗୁହାଳ ପୋଛି ଅନ୍ୟ ଜଣେ ଅଧିକାର ପାଇଲା—ଏହା ବକ୍ତାର ଅଭିଯୋଗ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ନିଜ ଅବଦାନର ସ୍ୱୀକୃତି ନମିଳି ଅନ୍ୟ ଜଣଙ୍କ ପ୍ରଭାବ ବଢ଼ିବାର କ୍ଷୋଭ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।
explanation: The speaker places two contributions side by side: providing food and drink, and cleaning a cowshed. The first, the speaker complains, brought no standing; the second brought someone else authority. Our editorial reading hears resentment at the difference between effort and recognition. The verse gives the speaker’s comparison, leaving the people and their arrangement unnamed.
usage_example: Original imagined example: In a reading discussion, someone hears a complaint that providing resources did not bring influence while another person’s daily work did. A second reader asks whether the speaker’s resentment tells the whole story. The exchange explores the verse’s perspective.
cultural_context: The first-person feeding verbs end in the self-effacing “became nothing.” The next line shifts to another person gaining authority, with cowshed cleaning as the concrete action. That change of grammatical person makes the unequal outcomes audible.
